identity.title: Ingredients for solar-like systems: protostar IRAS 16293-2422 B versus comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: The comparative analysis of the observations from the Protostellar Interferometric Line Survey (PILS) and the measurements made with Rosetta Orbiter Spectrometer for Ion and Neutral Analysis (ROSINA)

question.value: Do relative abundances of volatiles in protostar IRAS 16293-2422 B correlate with bulk abundances in comet 67P/C-G, i.e. are cometary ingredients inherited from protostellar phases?

evidence.quote: The goal of this paper is to compare the chemical inventories of these two targets and thereby test the chemical links that may or may not exist between cometary and interstellar volatiles.

The binary system was also observed in ALMA Band 9 under project-id 2011.0.00007.SV during the Science Verification phase.

findings_qualitative.value: Cometary relative abundances tend to be higher than protostellar ones for CHO- and N-bearing species

evidence.quote: the relative abundance ratios of 67P/C–G tend to be higher than those of IRAS 16293-2422 for CHO- and N-bearing species

claims.hypothesis: Cometary bulk volatiles correlate with protostellar disc-scale volatiles
claims.experiment: Compare PILS abundances at B with ROSINA bulk abundances per chemical family
claims.finding: Volatile composition of comets is partially inherited from protostellar phases

evidence.quote: The results imply that the volatile composition of cometesimals and planetesimals is partially inherited from the pre- and protostellar phases of evolution.

claims.hypothesis: P- and Cl-bearing species also correlate

evidence.quote: The correlation tentatively suggests that cometary and protostellar P- and Cl-bearing volatiles are related.

limitations_admitted.value: Many points are upper limits or estimates; isomers unresolved by ROSINA; symmetric molecules invisible to ALMA

evidence.quote: it is not possible to determine the abundance of symmetric molecules such as N$_{2}$, CH$_{4}$, CS$_{2}$, and CO$_{2}$

referee_caveats_inferred: Correlation significance in S and P/Cl families is low
